summary: VOI telemetry event added at the selection site in src/extension_scoring.rs. The .map(closure) that produces the final BTreeSet now emits tracing::info!(target: pi.runtime.math_technique_fire, math_technique=voi, fire_reason=voi_utility_estimation, selected_count) before returning. The IPS/WIS/DR estimators themselves are NOT implemented as named functions in extension_scoring.rs — only the VOI planner is concrete. A follow-up bead (MATH-IPS-UNIT-TEST) is needed to either implement IPS/WIS/DR or de-scope the README's 'IPS/WIS/DR + ESS + regret gate' claim.
next_actions: Run cargo check --lib to confirm the change compiles
Add a regression test that drives the trigger and asserts the event fires
